claims: Afroman (Joseph Foreman) lives in Winchester, Ohio.
Winchester, Ohio is located approximately 50 miles outside of Cincinnati.
Afroman's residence was raided by local law enforcement in August 2022.
Afroman featured the raid on his residence in his music videos.
The 2022 raid on Afroman's home prompted the song and music video "Lemon Pound Cake".
